description: Update fields on an existing client record — only the fields you pass change. No card or billing data is accepted. cross_regional_update (Mindbody default: true) also updates the client's profiles at the region's other sites. Pass test: true to validate only. Mindbody: POST /client/updateclient.

client_id.description: The client's ID (RSSID — a string, as configured by the business; see mindbody_list_clients).

cross_regional_update.description: Propagate to the client's profiles at the region's other sites (Mindbody default: true).

gender.description: Gender, as configured at the site (see the site's genders).

is_prospect.description: Mark the client as a prospect (only if the site allows prospects).

referred_by.description: How the client was referred (one of the site's referral types).

send_account_emails.description: Opt in/out of account notification emails.

send_schedule_emails.description: Opt in/out of schedule notification emails.

test.description: When true, Mindbody validates the request but commits nothing. Use it to dry-run a write.

name: mindbody_update_client
title: Update a client
